paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Shapley values by relative position to the probed target word. The values are averaged over the tasks.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the Shapley values for three models—mBERT, XLM-R, and chLSTM—across various relative positions to a probed target word. The horizontal axis represents the relative position, labeled L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺, and ordered from left to right. The vertical axis represents the “Shapley value”, and is linearly scaled from 0 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The bars are grouped, with each group containing three bars representing the respective models: mBERT in light blue, XLM-R in dark blue, and chLSTM in light green. The shortest bar, associated with chLSTM at position L₄⁺, has an approximate value of 3, while the tallest bar, corresponding to mBERT at position T, has an approximate value of 78. Generally, the chLSTM bars are consistently shorter than the other two models. Some bars are visually emphasized with a darker shade of the respective color. The bars are not sorted in any obvious order.
